title: Keep Windows Startup agents connected and bound Linux accessibility waits.
changes: Preserve a healthy Windows Startup agent launched under a kernel Job Object without a Node IPC channel; retain shutdown-on-disconnect for legacy IPC-supervised children.
Keep Job Object containment and verified empty process trees when the supervisor stops, without changing existing pairing credentials.
Respect the caller's deadline in Linux AT-SPI snapshots and their empty-tree retries for wait_for_ui; resolve cached semantic targets before invalidating the tree.
Harden native Windows supervisor regression cleanup against transient file locks, while preserving orphan-process detection.
Cover Windows x64 native lifecycle and Linux accessibility deadline regressions; release after verified package parity and security/CI gates.
